rationale: Brunello genome-wide knockout screen (77,441 guides, 1,000 non-targeting) in ACE2-expressing HEK293T cells infected with SARS-CoV-2 spike-pseudotyped mNeonGreen retrovirus, sorted into reporter-low (uninfected) and reporter-high cells. The GEO file puts three screens side by side; prepare.R splits it into one count file per screen (counts unchanged), with columns Pre/Input/Low/High matching the GSM titles. Host factors needed for entry or reporter expression (e.g. ACE2) are enriched in the reporter-low bin, so the contrast is low vs high. One library per bin, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path with an overdispersion pooled over the non-targeting guides; calls are screening-level. The presort and plasmid libraries are not used in the contrast.
